Read the following landlord notice and extract the information about the rent change. If a field is not specified in the notice, return an empty string for strings. For new_rent_amount, return the new total monthly rent amount (as a number). For effective_date, return the date at which the new rent takes effect in format YYYY-MM-DD if available. Set has_rent_change to true if the notice contains a rent change.

Dear tenant,
Please note that starting from next month, the rent will be 
increased by 100.00. Please make sure to adjust your standing
order accordingly.
Best regards,
Your landlord
